doctorAbout.title: About
doctorAbout.short_description: Dr.Gopalakrishnan is a highly experienced professional with years of experience in the field of Gastrointestinology and Endoscopic techniques. Having worked in various professional setups and having undergone meticulous training in leading institutions, Dr. Gopalakrishnan is also a recipient of the prestigious Dr. PN Berry Scholarship, 1998-1998.
